_doc: Styles of the specials agent's rooms (Sapphire's unique rooms). Each copies the Black 2 room closest to Sapphire's look (texture roles measured on that room's chunk with b2tools/specials.py chunk_materials/wall_uv); src = that room's texture set, which is also its area: the room's zone uses that area (data/interiors/<zone>.json "area"), so most of the textures are already in the area's set. black = wall caps (Black 2 draws them black).

sp_theater._doc: Nimbasa's Musical Theater lobby (zone 77, area 305): pink patterned floor in24_yuka, pink wall in24_kabe, the pink-to-black entrance gradient in24_in. Contest lobbies.

sp_stage._doc: Contest halls: the Musical Theater's floor with its purple stage curtain in24_carten as the wall (Sapphire's halls have a curtain wall).

sp_gamecorner._doc: Mauville Game Corner: the Musical Theater's red carpet in24_carpet as the floor, Nimbasa's Battle Test teal wall in25kabe_01 (set 306) for Sapphire's sky-blue wall.

sp_museum._doc: Nacrene Museum (zone 17, area 287): blue diamond floor in6yuka_02, white museum wall in6kabe_01 (Black 2 maps it 32 units across, 48 high). Oceanic Museum.

sp_artmuseum._doc: Lilycove Museum 1F: Nacrene Museum's wood parquet in6yuka_01_2 (16 units a repeat, as Black 2) and white wall.

sp_gallery._doc: Lilycove Museum 2F (gray stone tiles in Sapphire): Nacrene Museum's white tiles in6yuka_01 and white wall.

sp_school._doc: Aspertia Trainers' School (zone 436, area 286): classroom floor in05_yuka3 (40 units a repeat, as Black 2), white wall with a gray baseboard in05_sch_ka3, the school's stone entrance in05_genkan.

sp_fanclub._doc: Icirrus Pokémon Fan Club (zone 119, area 307): wood floor in26_yuka_01 (16 units), green wallpaper in26_kabe_02.

sp_center._doc: Black 2's Pokémon Center (zone 8, area 283): orange tile floor in02_yuka6, white Center wall in02_pckabe. Pokémon League lobby (a Center in Sapphire).

sp_cave._doc: Fossil Maniac's tunnel: Clay Tunnel's brown cave (texture set 332, area 332): dirt floor d29_yuka1, brown rock d29cliff as the walls (3 repeats up the wall), the Center's dark entrance gradient chip_ent (set 283) at the exit.

sp_wood._doc: Route 3 Day Care (zone 323, area 282): wood plank wall in01_wall2, light wood floor b01_yuka2. Day Care, Seashore House, Flower Shop, Bike Shop.

sp_tiles._doc: Bike Shop / Flower Shop (gray-white tiles in Sapphire): Pokémon Center gray tiles in02_yuka7 (set 283) with the wood wall in01_wall2 (set 282).

sp_elevator._doc: Department Store elevator: Castelia office tiles b06_yuka3 and wall b06_kabe8 (set 341, Castelia building with Black 2's elevator door).

sp_trick._doc: Trick House puzzle room: Sapphire's green floor = the green check mat b01_mat1 of Black 2's houses (set 282), wood wall in01_wall2.

sp_battle._doc: Battle Tower: Nimbasa's Battle Test room (zone 93, area 306): teal diamond floor in25yuka_01 (16 units a repeat, as Black 2), blue-white wall in25kabe_01.

sp_battleroom._doc: Battle Tower battle room (yellow floor in Sapphire): the Battle Subway's yellow floor gs_yuka_c (set 330) and the Battle Test wall.
